canonical_definition:
What it is. Across the surveyed work, NTREX-128 is described as a document-translation dataset. Definitions place it in FILBENCH for English-to-Filipino translation evaluation, and source snippets describe it as part of a "diverse set of test examples" that include documents.

What it is claimed to measure. In the recorded relationships, papers use NTREX-128 to measure Machine translation. It is linked to one behavioral indicator, Machine translation, and to no constructs, so the reported use centers on a single behavioral target rather than multiple constructs or indicators.

Space of uses. Papers position NTREX-128 as part of a broader machine translation evaluation setup rather than as a standalone protocol. One paper lists it alongside FLORES-200, AfroLingu-MT, TICO-19, and MAFAND-MT under MT datasets, and no measurement instrument is formally linked to it in the recorded relationships.
